definitions.dedup: Identical event/reason/state records are coalesced per owner; this is not a callback counter.
definitions.guard_reason: Actual first rejecting expression, evaluated once in original short-circuit order.
definitions.observation: Account/policy values are retained only from original reads. Read uptime marks their age; logging does not trigger new identity/policy reads.
definitions.snapshot: Only result/geometry is logged; no pixels, account IDs, group IDs or message text.
definitions.timing: Callback sample uptime, not physical touch timing or frame cost.
